"""Independently test the sanitized Python claims on CPython 3.13.0."""

import importlib
from importlib.machinery import ModuleSpec
import json
import platform
import symtable
import sys
from types import ModuleType


assert sys.implementation.name == "cpython"
assert sys.version_info == (3, 13, 0, "final", 0)
assert sys._git[2] == "60403a5"


class FixtureFinder:
    def __init__(self):
        self.calls = []
        self.failed = set()

    def find_spec(self, fullname, path=None, target=None):
        if fullname.startswith("_sces_probe_"):
            self.calls.append((fullname, path, target))
            return ModuleSpec(fullname, self)

    def create_module(self, spec):
        return None

    def exec_module(self, module):
        assert sys.modules[module.__name__] is module
        if module.__name__ in self.failed:
            importlib.import_module("_sces_probe_side_effect")
            raise RuntimeError("independent fixture load failure")


def import_error(operation, exception_type):
    try:
        operation()
    except exception_type as exc:
        return exc
    raise AssertionError(f"Expected {exception_type.__name__}")


finder = FixtureFinder()
sys.meta_path.insert(0, finder)
top = "_sces_probe_top"
sys.modules[top] = None
assert import_error(lambda: importlib.import_module(top), ModuleNotFoundError).name == top
assert finder.calls == []
del sys.modules[top]
assert importlib.import_module(top).__name__ == top
assert finder.calls == [(top, None, None)]

parent = ModuleType("_sces_probe_parent")
sys.modules[parent.__name__] = parent
child = f"{parent.__name__}.child"
assert import_error(lambda: importlib.import_module(child), ModuleNotFoundError).name == child
assert len(finder.calls) == 1
cached_name = f"{parent.__name__}.cached"
sys.modules[cached_name] = ModuleType(cached_name)
assert importlib.import_module(cached_name) is sys.modules[cached_name]
assert len(finder.calls) == 1
parent.__path__ = []
assert importlib.import_module(child).__name__ == child
assert finder.calls[-1][1] is parent.__path__

class ParentWithBrokenPath(ModuleType):
    def __getattr__(self, key):
        raise RuntimeError(f"custom lookup: {key}")


broken_parent = ParentWithBrokenPath("_sces_probe_broken_parent")
sys.modules[broken_parent.__name__] = broken_parent
broken_child = f"{broken_parent.__name__}.child"
assert str(import_error(lambda: importlib.import_module(broken_child), RuntimeError)) == "custom lookup: __path__"

failed = "_sces_probe_failed"
finder.failed.add(failed)
assert str(import_error(lambda: importlib.import_module(failed), RuntimeError)) == "independent fixture load failure"
assert failed not in sys.modules
assert "_sces_probe_side_effect" in sys.modules
assert sys.modules[top].__name__ == top
finder.failed.clear()
initial = importlib.import_module(failed)
finder.failed.add(failed)
import_error(lambda: importlib.reload(initial), RuntimeError)
assert sys.modules[failed] is initial

class AnnotationCase:
    element = dict
    type Alias = element

    def ordinary_method(self):
        return element


assert AnnotationCase.Alias.__value__ is dict
import_error(AnnotationCase().ordinary_method, NameError)

alias_calls = []


def compute_alias():
    alias_calls.append("resolved")
    return int


type Deferred = compute_alias()
assert alias_calls == []
assert Deferred.__value__ is int and alias_calls == ["resolved"]
Eager = compute_alias()
assert Eager is int and alias_calls == ["resolved", "resolved"]

generic = "def outer[T]():\n    def inner():\n        nonlocal T\n        T = None\n"
type_parameter_error = import_error(lambda: compile(generic, "<type parameter>", "exec"), SyntaxError)
assert "nonlocal binding not allowed for type parameter" in str(type_parameter_error)
ordinary = "def outer():\n    T = str\n    def inner():\n        nonlocal T\n        T = int\n    inner()\n    return T\n"
control_namespace = {}
exec(ordinary, control_namespace)
assert control_namespace["outer"]() is int
generic_reader = "def outer[T]():\n    def inner():\n        return T\n    return inner()\n"
exec(generic_reader, control_namespace)
assert control_namespace["outer"]() is control_namespace["outer"].__type_params__[0]

example = "class Example:\n    def direct(self):\n        nonlocal __class__\n        return __class__\n"
method_table = symtable.symtable(example, "<implicit class>", "exec").get_children()[0].get_children()[0]
symbol = method_table.lookup("__class__")
assert symbol.is_nonlocal() and symbol.is_free() and not symbol.is_local()
namespace = {}
exec(example, namespace)
example_class = namespace["Example"]
assert example_class.direct.__code__.co_freevars == ("__class__",)
assert example_class().direct() is example_class

class_member_control = "class Example:\n    member = 1\n    def direct(self):\n        nonlocal member\n        return member\n"
class_member_error = import_error(lambda: symtable.symtable(class_member_control, "<class member>", "exec"), SyntaxError)
assert "no binding for nonlocal 'member' found" in str(class_member_error)

print(json.dumps({
    "runtime": sys.version,
    "implementation": platform.python_implementation(),
    "platform": platform.system(),
    "cases": {
        "none_cache": {"sentinel_raises": True, "missing_dispatches": True},
        "parent_path": {"missing_rejected": True, "cached_child_accessible": True, "custom_exception_propagates": True},
        "finder_path": {"top_level_is_none": True, "child_path_identity_for_empty_list": True},
        "initial_load_cleanup": {"failing_entry_removed": True, "side_effect_retained": True, "existing_entry_retained": True,
                                 "failing_reload_entry_retained": True},
        "annotation_scope": {"class_alias_reads_class_name": True, "ordinary_method_cannot": True},
        "lazy_alias": {"creation_calls": 0, "after_value_access_calls": 1, "assignment_is_eager": True},
        "nonlocal_type_parameter": {"diagnostic": type_parameter_error.msg, "ordinary_nonlocal_rebinds": True,
                                     "type_parameter_read_succeeds": True},
        "implicit_class_nonlocal": {"is_nonlocal": symbol.is_nonlocal(), "is_free": symbol.is_free(),
                                    "is_local": symbol.is_local(), "co_freevars": example_class.direct.__code__.co_freevars,
                                    "returns_enclosing_class": True, "ordinary_class_member_diagnostic": class_member_error.msg},
    },
}, indent=2, sort_keys=True))
